title: Scoreline
tagline: One goal event, every viewer, no refresh.
summary: Match timelines, line-ups and league tables pushed to fans the moment they change, over WebSockets.
problem: Fans want the goal on their screen the second it happens, not after a refresh.
why: Live scores are a hard problem dressed as an easy one: many people watching the same data at once, all expecting it to change under them without a refresh. I am building Scoreline to get that push path right, with timelines, line-ups and tables all updating in place.
note: In development; the demo is coming.
hard: One goal event must reach every viewer instantly.
